title: Industrial Nexus: Core Loop
summary: Balance inputs, heat, coolant, power, and diagnostics before scaling a line.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Gather materials, process them through machines, use byproducts, upgrade bottlenecks, and keep diagnostics nearby so failure is visible.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each production pass, check the bottleneck: input rate, power draw, heat, coolant, output storage, or maintenance. Scale only the part that is limiting throughput.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop before the line runs unattended beyond its buffers. A paused factory is easier to fix than a hot, starved, overloaded one.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
